entries.source:
Surround yourself with a shield that will absorb %d%% of any physical/acid/nature/temporal attack, up to a maximum of %d damage per attack.
		Every time your shield absorbs damage, you convert some of the attack into energy, gaining one point of Psi, plus an additional point for every %0.1f points of damage absorbed, up to a maximum %0.1f points each turn.
		At talent level 3, when you de-activate the shield twice the absorbed damage (if any) in the last 3 turns is released as a full psionic shield (absorbing all damage).
		The maximum amount of damage your shield can absorb and the efficiency of the psi gain scale with your mindpower.
		You can only have two of these shields active at once.
entries.target:
用护盾环绕自己，吸收 %d%% 物理、酸性、自然、时空伤害，每次最多吸收 %d 伤害。
		每次你的护盾吸收伤害时，将部分攻击转化为能量，获得 1 点灵能值；每吸收 %0.1f 点伤害，还会额外获得 1 点灵能值，每回合最多获得 %0.1f 点灵能值。
		技能等级达到 3 时，关闭护盾会将此前 3 回合吸收的伤害（若有）的两倍转化为一个全效灵能护盾（吸收所有伤害）。
		护盾每次最多能吸收的伤害以及获得灵能值的效率随精神强度提高。
		你同时只能维持两个此类护盾。

entries.source: %d%% of all damage is redirected to a random shadow.
entries.target: %d%% 的总伤害被转移至随机某个阴影。

entries.source:
Nagas are invading the slazish fens. The Sunwall cannot fight on two fronts; you need to stop the invaders before it is too late.
 Locate and destroy the invaders' portal.
entries.target:
娜迦正在攻击斯拉伊什沼泽，太阳堡垒不能同时两线作战，你必须抓紧时间阻止那些侵略者，以免为时过晚。
 找到并摧毁侵略者的传送门。

entries.source:
A finishing uppercut that deals %d%% damage, and attempts to stun your target for %d to %d turns, depending on the amount of combo points you've accumulated.
		The stun chance will improve with your Physical Power.
		Using this talent removes your combo points.
entries.target:
以一记终结性的上勾拳对目标造成 %d%% 伤害，并尝试将其震慑 %d 至 %d 回合（取决于你积累的连击点数）。
		震慑概率受物理强度加成。
		使用此技能会消耗当前的所有连击点。

entries.source:
#GOLD#Lives#LAST#
How many lives you have and how many you lost.
Your total number of lives depends on the permadeath setting you choose.
You may find other ways to save yourself but they are not considered extra lives.
entries.target:
#GOLD#生命数#LAST#
你的生命数以及你的死亡次数。
你的总生命数取决于你的死亡模式设定。
你可以获得其他的复活机会，但这不视为额外的生命数。

entries.source: Mana represents your reserve of magical energies. Most spells cast consume mana and each sustained spell reduces your maximum mana.
entries.target: 法力值代表你存储的魔法能量。大部分法术都要消耗法力值，持续法术技能会降低你的最大法力值。
